, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner reversed the comparison of birth years—treating Takhir Sabirov (born 1929) as earlier/older than Jean Yarbrough (born 1900)—and thus incorrectly concluded that The Last Night of Scheherazade had the director born first instead of Leave It to Henry.
